channel.title: Crier
channel.description: Sparkle appcast for Crier.app automatic updates.

item.description:
• Drag works from anywhere on the chip body. Previous build had WindowDragRegion as a .background of the icon+text section; SwiftUI's hit-testing was claiming the clicks before they fell through to the AppKit drag view, so drag only fired on padding gaps. Moved the drag region to an .overlay (in front of the visible content) so every mouseDown on the chip body lands on it directly. Click without movement still selects the tab; only the ⋮ kebab is exempt.
  • Clearer mute wording. Kebab labels now read "Mute session for 10 mins" / "Mute session for 30 mins" (was "Mute 10 min" / "Mute 30 min") so the per-session scope is unambiguous.

• Correct icon for cursor-agent sessions. Both ~/.cursor/hooks.json and ~/.claude/settings.json Stop hooks fire on the same cursor-agent turn; the server's first-wins dedup picked claude-code ~half the time and the panel rendered the Claude icon for what was actually a Cursor turn. crier-emit now walks the parent process chain when invoked as claude-code and early-exits if cursor-agent is an ancestor.
  • Unified tab strip. Single row of chips replaces the AgentBadge + tab-strip pair that duplicated the selected session. Each chip = brand icon + project label + vertical ⋮ kebab. Opaque system-adaptive backgrounds, no vibrancy bleed.
  • Per-tab kebab actions. "Disable for this session" + "Mute 10 min" / "Mute 30 min". All release the blocking hook so the agent's terminal doesn't freeze, drop the tab, and switch the panel to the next session (or hide if none). Mute auto-expires by deadline.
  • Drag-or-tap chip body. Click selects the tab; drag moves the panel.
  • Panel re-centers on full dismiss. Resets userPositionedPanel so a one-time drag in any session no longer pins every future overlay across different projects/agents/hours.

• Summarize / Hide summary buttons read as real buttons. Earlier attempts (.tertiary, Color.primary.opacity(0.12), .regularMaterial) all composited with the panel's vibrancy and came out almost invisible. The pill is now a fully opaque controlBackgroundColor base + primary tint + a thin border, so it stands out against the frosted panel.

• Panel actually re-centers when content grows. 0.8.2's centering fix only ran inside applyContentSize, but the panel resizes most of the time via NSHostingView's intrinsic-size pipeline (which doesn't go through that path), so the recenter never fired. Moved the recenter into windowDidResize on the panel delegate — covers every resize regardless of which code path triggered it.

• Fix OpenCode "Install Selected" appending duplicates. 0.8.2's Crier-entry filter was case-sensitive on "crier", so paths like /Applications/Crier.app/Contents/Resources/agent-assets/opencode-plugin/dist/index.js (capital C) weren't recognized as ours and each click added another copy. Match is case-insensitive now, AND non-Crier entries are de-duplicated as a side effect — one click on 0.8.3 cleans up an opencode.json that's accumulated 0.8.2 duplicates.

• OpenCode is now a first-class agent: bundled inside Crier.app, one-click install from the Setup window — no npm, git, or opencode plugin CLI dance. Just check the box and click Install Selected. The pre-built plugin lives at /Applications/Crier.app/Contents/Resources/agent-assets/opencode-plugin/dist/index.js and is wired into ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json by absolute path.
  • OpenCode now honors Pause / Disable: the plugin reads the same /tmp/crier-agent/ silence flags as crier-emit, so menu-bar Pause and the /crier off skill silence OpenCode events too (previously they kept firing during a pause).
  • Panel re-centers when content grows: longer assistant messages no longer push the overlay off-center toward the bottom of the screen if you haven't dragged it.
  • "Summary" tag sits above the summary card now instead of overlapping its first line; the Summarize button uses a solid fill so it stays readable on translucent backgrounds.

• Dedup actually works now: 0.8.0 added the dedup logic but crier-emit wasn't sending transcript_path in its POST payload, so the server's key-match always missed. One overlay per cursor turn, instead of two — verified against a real cursor session.
  • Logs in local time: every Crier log line now uses your timezone (e.g. +02:00) instead of UTC. Wall-clock timestamps match what Console / Finder show.
  • New regression test for the payload shape so the dedup field can't silently disappear again.

• Cursor support fixed: parser now reads Cursor's role:"assistant" transcript envelope, the project name is recovered from transcript_path when stdin reports ~/.cursor, and duplicate stop hooks (cursor + claude-code firing for one cursor turn) are deduped server-side so you see one overlay per turn instead of two.
  • Reveal Logs in Finder…: new menu item stages every Crier log into a single folder and opens Finder there for quick triage.
  • Send Feedback now embeds the tails of crier-ui.log, crier-emit.log, and the empty-message diagnostic inline.

• Hook installer no longer writes App Translocation paths — Cursor/Claude/Codex configs keep working after Crier quits.
  • If you launched Crier only from Downloads/DMG, Setup now asks you to drag the app into Applications before wiring hooks.

• Pause in the menu bar: silence hooks for 10 or 30 minutes, or cancel anytime.
  • Works with global disable; crier-emit honors the same pause file when the UI is not running.

• Sparkle automatic updates with a Check for Updates… item in the menu bar.
  • SUFeedURL points at this appcast; installs use the signed Crier.app.zip from GitHub Releases.
